ownerAuthority: Finish Inspector search/filter tests under the existing 300-second auto idle rule; preserve active owner input and update GitHub.

findings.finding: Physical Inspector search crashed when an own AX read lazily created AppKit rows on the RPC worker thread.
findings.fix: Own reads and target revalidation run on the main thread before cache locking; operation generations and paused observations remain intact.

findings.finding: Command+A left the previous Inspector query intact, so the next typed query appended.
findings.fix: Add a standard responder-chain Edit menu with normal Mac shortcuts. Read the About version from bundle metadata.

findings.finding: A deliberately retired real listener port was retained by the previous tracker.
findings.fix: Retire invalid or unsuccessfully re-enabled ports and recreate with a bounded retry cadence and a fresh idle interval.

findings.finding: A live test remained queued after the shared preference changed to permanent alongside.
findings.resolution: Restored the owner-authorized auto policy. Permanent alongside deliberately disables auto monitoring; expose validated monitor states and local writer/parent PID metadata for diagnosis.

findings.finding: The selected fixture appeared before Inspect Window became enabled, and the fixture control count changed after enhanced Accessibility.
findings.resolution: Wait for the exact selected fixture and enabled button; reacquire controls. Stop on owner input, saved-policy changes, or native PID changes, without repeating uncertain actions.

physicalChecks.name: Window choice and physical Inspect Window
Physical row selection shows correct identifier and Unicode value
Prior foreground restored without clipboard input

limits: These physical checks use a disposable third-party native fixture, not every Mac application.
Background app behavior remains app-dependent; physical desktop input is shared and delivered input cannot be recalled.
Listener recovery was verified with deliberate fixture invalidation; it was not proven to cause the observed permanent-alongside wait.
AX budgets are checked between messages, not hard real-time deadlines.
The arm64 app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; other Macs may require their own permission setup.
